notes: Bodyweight exercises can now be graded with no weight entered. An unweighted pull-up or push-up was rejected outright and scored zero. The load is now your bodyweight times a published fraction for the movement - pull-up 1.0, dip 0.95, push-up 0.64, inverted row 0.6 - plus anything strapped on, so a 20 lb belt on a 138 lb body scores as the 158 lb actually moving
The bodyweight used is recorded at the moment you log the set, so an old session is always scored with the bodyweight that was true that day, not today
Fix: a movement with no published ratio table, such as pull-ups and dips, entered the Strength average as a zero and dragged it down

Discipline now has two halves. It was frequency only, and the streak it displayed counted for nothing. Continuity, meaning how regularly you turn up, now carries 30 percent, built from smooth signals rather than a streak counter so that one hard week costs a few points instead of wiping the score
